propositions: RemoteRef.instance is never constructed or populated in production code, only in tests, making deployment identity unobservable on the inbound path
The Backend port does not declare a remote_ref() method, but FakeBackend has implemented it since J7, creating an asymmetry where contract tests exercise capabilities production does not provide

instance should be derived from the configured base URL at backend construction time and injected by build_backend factories, not resolved at call time, to avoid config-context dependencies in contract tests
RemoteRef.instance does not prevent local-ticket-id collision between two same-vendor deployments because _jira_key_to_local_id derives ids from Jira keys alone, independent of instance

vendor already separates Cloud from DataCenter deployments, so instance only disambiguates multiple deployments of the same vendor, and the docstring claiming instance prevents same-vendor collision is incorrect

The ADRs 0055 and 0035 must be amended to clarify that instance is not persisted and therefore does not suffer stability issues from mutable base URLs, and that it does not solve the local-id collision problem
